messages.subject: shiny + sigma.gs: minimal example
parts:
Dear all, 

I am trying to include some graph visualisation using sigma.js in a shiny app. So far, I am trying to work out a minimal example, and got stuck with an oddity. The page opened via "runApp()" does not seem to work, but when copying its source to create a new file "shinyOutput.html", then this page gives the expected result.

Here's my ui.R:
##########
library(shiny)

shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(
  headerPanel("shiny & sigma.js"),

  sidebarPanel(
               h1("Panel for inputs")
  ),

  mainPanel(
            tags$head(
                      tags$link(rel = 'stylesheet', type = 'text/css', href = 'toto.css')
                      ),
            h2("There should be a graph below:"),
            includeHTML("showgraph.js"),
            div(id="container")
            )
))
##########

The short javascript showgraph.js simply reads a graph in json format to render it:
<script src="sigma.min.js"></script>
<script src="sigma.parsers.json.min.js"></script>
<script>
    sigma.parsers.json('graph.json', {
container: 'container',
settings: {
   defaultNodeColor: '#ec5148'
}
    });
</script>

As for the css file, it is quite simple:
body {
    margin: 0;
}
#container {
    position: absolute;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
}

The R console does not output any error. The only thing I can think of is that the input file "graph.json" may not be at the right place. I tried putting it in a directory www/ following some previous posts, but no luck. All files attached. Do not use Chrome to try the example, as it does not allow local inputs to be used (firefox or other mozillas work).

Any idea most welcome!
Cheers
Thibaut

messages.subject: Re: shiny + sigma.gs: minimal example
parts:
Dont know whether you still face the issue with loading the graph, but it works for me. I moved all the JS files into www directory. Then it failed to load complaining it could not find the showgraph.js. So I edited your ui.r like this includeHTML("./www/showgraph.js"). It works now. Hopefully it helps someone.

Cheers,
Anand
